name: Co Le pagoda
summary: Walk the lotus tower, then the hall, about 15 km from the city. The tower is counted as 12 storeys and as 9 storeys, and the height with the 9-storey count is 32 m. The stair is 60 steps and also 64. The bell is 9 tons and 3.2 m, cast in 1936, and also about 4.2 m. A ticket and a gate hour are check on arrival.
getThere: About 15 km from the city on đường 21.
heroCaption: The lotus tower, full height, from the road
body: The tower stands in the pond on a turtle, in front of the gate. It is counted as 12 storeys, built from 1926 to 1927, with 60 steps. It is also counted as 9 storeys and 32 m, built in 1927, with 64 steps and a base of 18 m by 10 m. The bell is 9 tons and 3.2 m, cast in 1936, and also about 4.2 m with a mouth of 2.2 m. The main hall is 29 m.

The town is thị trấn Cổ Lễ, huyện Trực Ninh, tỉnh Nam Định, and also xã Cổ Lễ, tỉnh Ninh Bình. From the city, cross the suspension bridge on sông Đào, then about 15 km on đường 21, a small bridge, and 200 m to the right. The road minute is check on arrival. A gate hour and a ticket are check on arrival. Go for the tower in the pond, and leave the storey count as two numbers.

figures.caption: The yellow hall and the bell in the court
figures.alt: The yellow hall of Co Le pagoda, with a bell in the court and bare trees in front

gettingThere: The pagoda is about 15 km from the city. Cross the suspension bridge on sông Đào, follow đường 21, cross a small bridge, and turn 200 m to the right. Minutes on that road are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Nam Dinh
legs.body: About 15 km on đường 21 after the suspension bridge on sông Đào, then 200 m to the right. The minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: The train reaches Ga Nam Định at kilometre 87 in 1 hour 40 minutes or 1 hour 41 minutes. The fare is check on arrival. The road minute from the station out to Cổ Lễ is check on arrival.

admissionNote: Check on arrival. No child price is recorded.
